predecessors.name: Moghulistan
predecessors.text: western Moghulistan, Mahmud Khan's part: 'ruler of western Moghulistan in Tashkent'; the Cliopatria 1491 Moghulistan shape minus its 1492 shape

successors.name: Moghulistan
successors.text: the Zhetysu of the Eastern Chagatai shape, which Cliopatria re-absorbs into its Moghulistan row in 1512

ledger.x: 1492: the western Moghuls under Mahmud Khan hold Tashkent and the Zhetysu as a khanate of their own.
1511: the Moghuls are gone from the Tian Shan.

wars.name: Shaybani's war against Mahmud Khan and Ahmad Alaq
wars.outcome: The brothers Mahmud and Ahmad Alaq were defeated and captured by Muhammad Shaybani's Uzbeks and Tashkent was seized; Mahmud later submitted to Shaybani, who executed him (the page ends his reign in 1508 and gives no year for the execution).

wars.name: Kyrgyz expulsion of the Moghuls
wars.outcome: By 1510-11 the Kyrgyz 'had effectively driven out the Moghuls' from the Tian Shan.

certainty.note: Steppe and mountain frontiers; the pages give no boundary of the khanate at all, and the shape is Cliopatria's outline.
